title: Claude Node Output Item
description: Shape of a single n8n output item emitted by the Claude node on success. Top-level additionalProperties are permitted so additive fields from the CLI surface without a node release (Constitution Principle II).

success.description: Always true for items in the success bucket. Downstream IF nodes can branch on this single field for success/failure routing.

response.description: The text content of Claude's response, extracted from the CLI's structured output. This is the field workflow authors will most often consume.

model.description: The model identifier the CLI reports it used. Optional because the CLI may not always include it (older versions, error fallbacks).

stopReason.description: Why generation stopped. Examples: 'end_turn', 'max_tokens', 'stop_sequence'. Optional for the same reason as 'model'.

usage.description: Token-count metadata when the CLI provides it.

raw.description: The full unparsed JSON object emitted by the CLI on stdout. Pass-through so downstream nodes can read fields the node has not promoted to top-level.

meta.description: Node-side observability metadata. Distinguishes node-attributed timing from CLI-attributed metadata.

elapsedMs.description: Wall-clock milliseconds from spawn() to subprocess exit, measured by the node.
